name_story.story: Samah can be understood through the Arabic form سَمَاح, whose central sense is samah; generosity, forgiveness. Samah is Arabic سَمَاح (Samāḥ), meaning 'generosity, forgiveness'.

faq.a: Samah is associated with the Arabic form سَمَاح, whose core sense is samah; generosity, forgiveness.

faq.q: What is the origin of Samah?
faq.a: Samah is associated with Arabic. Samah is Arabic سَمَاح (Samāḥ), meaning 'generosity, forgiveness'.
Yes — the underlying form سَمَاح is Arabic.
Samah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Samah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Samāḥ is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Samah mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Samah is rendered سماح and carries the sense سماح، سخاوت.

faq.q: What does Samah mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Samah is rendered سماح and carries the sense سماح، بخشش.
A romanized syllable approximation is sa-mah. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Samah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Samah, samah. Script forms are سماح, سَمَاح, समाह.

faq.q: Is Samah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
